scene: You zip down to a busy hub at the flats' edge.
picture: A stone terrace runs across the bottom. On the far left hangs an open ferris wheel gondola. Left of centre, the tall man in a red poncho, straw hat, and guitar lands safely. To his right waits an open brass book cart lift. On the far right sits a parked night bus with open doors.
shown: A glowing open ferris wheel gondola waiting at a platform on the far left
An empty brass book cart lift with its metal gate open on the right
A humming blue night bus parked with doors folded open on the far right
